clusters.story_title: SBA proposes race-neutral 8(a) overhaul; ANC federal contracting at stake
key_facts_to_verify: SBA published/announced proposed rule ~June 11, 2026 eliminating race-based social-disadvantage presumption for individual 8(a) applicants
Entity-owned participants (Alaska Native Corporations, tribes, NHOs) explicitly exempted/carved out

Indian-country / ANC contract award decline figure: AK Public Media June 12 cites 26% / $800M drop vs prior year; Fortune May 11 cites ANC funding down 46% through April 2026 (background). PIN which figure is which.
Public comment deadline: Beat B says July 13, 2026; Beats A/D say not yet published. RESOLVE.
HJR 44 unanimous bipartisan resolution transmitted to Gov. Dunleavy ~June 15 reaffirming ANC 8(a) participation. Confirm resolution number + date.
Federal News Network June 15 commentary authored by AK Rep. Maxine Dibert and AK Sen. Cathy Giessel
DoD Under Secretary Michael Duffey said ANC status is political, not racial, so survives rule change (AK Public Media June 12)
ANC subsidiaries named: ASRC Federal, Chenega, Chugach Government Solutions, Koniag Government Services in IT/AI/defense work

clusters.story_title: NSPM-12 signed June 12 pairs AI acceleration with NSS cyber governance; ANC defense contractors face compliance clock
key_facts_to_verify: NSPM-12 signed June 12, 2026; re-establishes Committee on National Security Systems; empowers NSA Director to issue binding cyber directives to NSS owners/operators
Cross-references NSPM-11 (June 5, 2026) AI acceleration memorandum
Directs DOD/IC to overhaul AI procurement within 120 days (deadline ~Oct 3, 2026), multi-vendor AI onboarding, contract-termination authority for 'repeated pattern of conduct'

clusters.story_title: XPRIZE Wildfire $11M finals run live in rural Alaska June 15-25; Anduril among finalists, UAF ACUASI test partner
key_facts_to_verify: Finals run June 15-25, 2026 in a ~1,000 km2 zone in rural Alaska
UAF Alaska Center for Unmanned Aircraft Systems Integration (ACUASI) is official testing partner
Finalists include Anduril, Dryad, Data Blanket, FireSwarm Solutions, Wildfire Quest
$11M total purse; teams must autonomously detect+suppress high-risk ignition in under 10 min; grand prize ~$3.5M

clusters.story_title: Alaska's $272M Rural Health Transformation grant enters AI-heavy shortlist; Tanana Chiefs drone delivery a finalist, awards July
key_facts_to_verify: $272M HHS/CMS Rural Health Transformation grant to Alaska Dept of Health (awarded Dec 2025)
400+ of ~1,800 proposals advanced; ~22% center on data/technology (AI diagnostics, telehealth, RPM, EHR)
Tanana Chiefs Conference drone delivery of vaccines/meds to Interior villages among finalists
Application window closes ~June 22, 2026; final awards expected July 2026
Rep. Genevieve Mina quote that program design is 'almost directing us to AI'
